metadata.limitations: no live provider or OpenCode/Codex comparison; embedded mode, controlled private config, three short turns, no long-session history; ignored-directory control uses sparse placeholder contents/names, not actual caches or private state
metadata.profiles: separate instrumented runs; CPU profiling starts in tagged main-package init (earlier dependency initialization excluded); heap allocations are sampled estimates, not retained RSS; quiet allocation profile is end-minus-initial
metadata.repeat: three fresh-process/private-state samples per configuration, sequential interleaving; OS page cache not cleared, module/build caches warmed by direct-command controls; no other builds/tests/benchmarks ran during measurements
metadata.sampling: ps numeric CPU/RSS and owned-process basename at100ms; CPU resolution10ms; peak RSS is sampled, transient peaks can be missed; sums of descendant RSS can double-count shared pages; elapsed UI detection uses50ms polls requiring two positive samples
metadata.scope: real tracked Marshal source, real embedded client RPC seam and PTY, private config/state/home, localhost scripted OpenAI-compatible provider; no running daemon or real configured provider used
metadata.workload: two 7-tool read/search/git/go-test/todo turns, then 12 distinct 200-line source reads; 29 provider requests and 26 successful persisted tool calls per run; context window131072; native tool schemas23; titling/narration/intent nudge disabled; auto enabled
